versions.changelog:
- Initial release of agent-crypto-trading skill.
- Enables autonomous gasless limit, DCA, stop-loss, and take-profit orders on 8 EVM chains.
- Provides complete workflow and relay endpoints for instruction-only crypto trading.
- Includes clear mapping from user intent to spot order payloads, with param normalization, signing, and submission guidance.
- Supports relay querying, order cancellation, and authoritative per-chain and adapter definitions.
